title: Wallpage: a browser 'screensaver' gallery of evolving generative scenes for TVs, second monitors and wall displays
user: Developers and design-minded people who miss collectible screensavers and want an ambient, evolving, clock-aware generative display for an idle screen or a TV, without installing anything.
current_workaround: Leave a CodePen/Shadertoy tab open, ElectricSheep, Apple aerials, YouTube ambient videos with ads.
gap: One URL that cycles a curated set of slow, evolving, seed-based generative scenes with optional clock/date, sleep schedule, and a seed of the day — no install, works on TV browsers and Chromecast.
smallest_useful_product: Full-screen page with about 10 original generative scenes, each seeded from date and time; clock overlay; auto-rotate; night dimming; keyboard and remote controls; shareable seed links.
constraints: GPU and thermal budget for hours-long runs, OLED burn-in avoidance, TV-browser limits, and original code/assets.
monetization: Free core gallery with a one-time Collector unlock for extra scenes; no ads.
